_comment: Rider identification schemes. The event picks one (divisions may override). 'primary' is the big label on every rider chip; 'secondary' items are shown smaller. Palette colour names are always rendered as TEXT as well as colour (colour-blind and white/black vests). See docs/06-SCREENS-UX.md section 0 and docs/05 (entries.identifiers).

schemes.name: Coloured vests / lycras assigned per heat (DEFAULT)
schemes.description: KOTA/GKA style: each slot in a heat has a colour from the palette; the rider wears that vest for that heat only.

schemes.name: One coloured lycra per rider for the whole event
schemes.description: Lycras handed out at registration; the colour stays with the rider. Draw avoids putting two riders with the same colour in one heat when possible and warns otherwise.

schemes.name: Bib / sail numbers
schemes.description: Numbers printed on vest, board or kite; primary identifier is the number.

schemes.name: Identify by kite (no vests available)
schemes.description: Riders on their own gear; the kite brand/model/size/colours plus rash guard colour identify them. Draw warns when two riders in a heat have similar kites.

schemes.name: Brand launch — most riders on the same kite brand
schemes.description: For events like a brand launch where everyone may fly the same kites: primary is the coloured vest if available, otherwise rash guard colour; secondary shows kite size + colourway + name; rider photo shown to spotter and judges.
